title: Synthetic-to-Real Code-Switched ASR: A Spontaneous Nepali-English Podcast Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.30860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nepali-English code-switched conversational speech presents severe challenges for automatic speech recognition (ASR), chiefly through script confusion (inappropriate mixing of Devanagari and Latin orthography) and elevated error rates at language switch points. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can adapt multilingual foundation models, but human code-switched audio is expensive to collect and annotate. We curate a new benchmark of 13,044 spontaneous podcast utterances (15.45 h total; 10,214 test, 2,830 dev), audited and verified to eliminate machine translation leakages and acoustic loops. We investigate a two-stage synthetic-to-real adaptation framework: Stage 1 applies SFT on 0.95 h of speech synthesized via a multi-speaker, dual-engine TTS pipeline; Stage 2 explores Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with transcription and script rewards. translated_title: 合成到真实的语码转换语音识别：一个自发性尼泊尔语-英语播客基准
translated_abstract: 尼泊尔语-英语语码转换的会话语音给自动语音识别（ASR）带来了严峻挑战，主要表现为文字系统混淆（天城文与拉丁字母书写方式的不当混用）以及语言切换点处错误率的升高。监督微调（SFT）可以适配多语言基础模型，但人工语码转换音频的收集与标注成本高昂。我们构建了一个新的基准数据集，包含13,044条自发性播客语句（总计15.45小时；测试集10,214条，开发集2,830条），并经过审核验证以消除机器翻译泄漏和声学循环问题。我们研究了一种两阶段的合成到真实适配框架：第一阶段对通过多说话人、双引擎TTS流程合成的0.95小时语音进行SFT；第二阶段探索使用转录奖励和文字系统奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。我们发现合成数据上的SFT为自发性人类语音提供了主要的跨域迁移。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个经过人工审核的13,044条尼泊尔语-英语语码转换自发性播客基准数据集，并提出两阶段合成到真实适配框架——先用TTS合成语音做SFT，再用带转录与文字系统奖励的GRPO——以低成本缓解文字系统混淆和语言切换点错误率高的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an audited benchmark of 13,044 spontaneous Nepali-English code-switched podcast utterances and a two-stage synthetic-to-real adaptation framework—SFT on TTS-synthesized speech followed by GRPO with transcription and script rewards—to mitigate script confusion and elevated error rates at language switch points.
